title: Kastelholm Castle

buildingCutout.basis: Native mapped castle outline, including the two open courtyards.

terrainReference.basis: Original NLS bare-earth elevation at the current visitor access outside the eastern castle wall.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap named castle enclosure, nearby visitor paths and present gate.
mapIdentity.scope: The named mapped exterior sets the castle’s asymmetric outline and the modern visitor approaches. Excavation records identify the long north–south footprint with a large northern and smaller southern courtyard, split by the central tower.

note: Exact Qualla photographs show the restored slate-gray metal gables, reddish granite, patches of lime render, brick window surrounds and low wall scars. Historic records give the original southwest keep as approximately 18–20 m high.
